programme.desc: Despite being the sole heir to a large fortune, Shanmugam is forced to work as a servant by his aunt. Later, she forces him to marry her own daughter in order to usurp his wealth.

programme.title: Murattu Singam
programme.desc: Rishi (Ravi Teja) is an inspector in the Intelligence Bureau. Rishi sends to Hyderabad and join in a college as a Hindi lecturer as a part of an undercover operation. He fall in love with her student Vinamra. Rishi has to extract information about Kittu from Vaishali, another student.

programme.title: Movie Contd - Murattu Singam
programme.desc: Simhachalam, a watchman is sentenced to death for stealing a precious diamond. However, a group of cowboys save Simhachalam and offer him the diamond, only on a condition that he fulfills a promise.

programme.title: Yogam Raja Yogam
programme.desc: When an unemployed Siva meets Usha, a spoilt brat, the two instantly clash with each other. Their relationship changes when Siva rescues her from a difficult situation.

programme.title: Galatta Ganapathy
programme.desc: A man gets married to a woman but when he brings her home, his mother demands dowry from her. However, things take a turn when he learns that she is a sub-inspector.

programme.title: Fillers
programme.desc: Fillers

programme.title: Adaavadi
programme.desc: An actress falls in love with an arrogant filmmaker and tries in vain to make him fall in love too. When he finally does, she leaves him for another man. The shattered man is unable to work any more.

programme.title: Narasimhan IPS
programme.desc: Menon, a retired police officer, becomes a victim of political rivalry when he admits to have killed a boy and is imprisoned. His daughters take it upon themselves to prove their father's innocence.

programme.title: Enn Purusan Kuzhantai Mathuri
programme.desc: A man gets involved with another woman just a day before he is to get married. After marriage, he lands in trouble when he confesses his mistake to his wife.

programme.title: Seevalaperi Pandi
programme.desc: Cast - Nepolean, Saranya | Descripiton - Seevalaperi Pandi (Napoleon), a brave man is married to Velammal (Saranya). They both live with her, his mother (Rangammal), and his elder brother Malayandi (Madhan Gabriel). The village leader, Grams (Vijayachander), impressed by Pandi's strength, hires him as his bodyguard.

programme.title: Youth
programme.desc: After a man's bride-to-be runs away on the night of his marriage, he decides to move on and soon falls in love with another woman. But she is already engaged to another man, who, it turns out, was the lover of his fiancee.

programme.title: Vaagai Soodavaa
programme.desc: Veluthambi, who aspires for a government job, finds himself teaching poor children in a village. When he learns that they are appointed as bonded labourers, he decides to bring about a change.

programme.title: Movie Contd - Vaagai Soodavaa
programme.desc: Veluthambi, who aspires for a government job, finds himself teaching poor children in a village. When he learns that they are appointed as bonded labourers, he decides to bring about a change.

programme.title: Neram Nallarukku
programme.desc: Ramarajan, a doctor by profession, falls in love with a woman named Jyothi. She reciprocates his feelings but is held back by her evil uncle, who tries to create a rift in their relationship.

programme.title: Akkarai Cheemayile
programme.desc: Akkarai Seemaiyile is a Tamil Feature Film starring Saravanan and more.

programme.title: Jai Hind
programme.desc: After his brother is killed in a terrorist attack, Bharath, a policeman, assures his mother that he will resign. However, when he learns of a secret terrorist organisation he sets out to capture them.

programme.title: Bala
programme.desc: Bala, a hitman in Pasupathi's gang, is madly in love with Aarthi, the daughter of a rival gangster. Bala faces several problems when both the gangs plan to end their rivalry.

programme.title: Kanni Raasi
programme.desc: Lakshmipathy falls in love with his sister's daughter, Dhanalakshmi. But when an astrologer predicts that Lakshmipathy will die when he marries Dhanalakshmi, his sister cancels the wedding.

programme.title: Mr.Romeo
programme.desc: A famous singer and dancer lives in Bangalore with his mother. He falls in love with a girl and their wedding is arranged. When he learns that a friend is involved in organ stealing racket; he confronts him and warns him of exposure.

programme.title: Anniyan
programme.desc: Ramanujam, who suffers from multiple personality disorder, works as a lawyer by day and a vigilante at night. He uses tips from the 'Garuda Purana' as his tools to expose various antisocial elements.

programme.title: Kadhal Alai
programme.desc: Uday, a rich businessman, falls in love with a simple girl named Sandhya. He gets to know that Sandhya is terminally ill but still pursues her and teaches her to seize every moment of her short life.

programme.title: Sevanthi
programme.desc: Sevanthi is daily family entertainment serial in Udaya TV. Arjun and Anuradha both are grandchildren of Pramoda Devi. However, because of tragedy befell on family of Anuradha, She end up growing as Sevanthi at an Ashram (orphanage) run by Shantamurthy. The Ashram one day lands in trouble as Sakshi, hailing from an elite family conspires to take over. To safeguard the ashram, Sevanthi approaches Arjun. The popular advocate Arjun put pre-condition of contractual marriage with her, only if Sevanthi agrees to that, he says, he will protect the Ashram. What would happen if a boy who has no belief in relationship and love marries a girl who lives breathing love and care is the knot of the tale.
